import sqlite3
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('ticketing')

def _grant_ticket_access(connection, ticket_id, customer_id):
    # Revoke the previous holder's entry/access rights and grant them to the new owner
    connection.execute('DELETE FROM ticket_access WHERE ticket_id = ?', (ticket_id,))
    connection.execute('INSERT INTO ticket_access (ticket_id, customer_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (ticket_id, customer_id, 'holder'))

@mcp.tool()
def refund_and_transfer_ticket_to_waitlist(ticket_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect('ticketing.db')
    ticket_record_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT payment_intent_id, event_id FROM tickets WHERE id = ?', (ticket_id,)).fetchone()
    next_waitlist_entry_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT id, customer_id FROM waitlist WHERE event_id = ? ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1', (ticket_record_row[1],)).fetchone()
    refund_confirmation_object = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=ticket_record_row[0])
    database_connection.execute('UPDATE tickets SET owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?', (next_waitlist_entry_row[1], ticket_id))
    database_connection.execute('DELETE FROM waitlist WHERE id = ?', (next_waitlist_entry_row[0],))
    _grant_ticket_access(database_connection, ticket_id, next_waitlist_entry_row[1])
    database_connection.commit()
    return f'Refund {refund_confirmation_object.id} issued; ticket moved to customer {next_waitlist_entry_row[1]}'
